title: Linking Silver Account with a Rho checking account
summary: Explains how to link a Rho-Bank Silver Account to a Rho-Bank checking account to earn a linked_checking_apy_bonus on Silver APY, and how maintaining multiple Rho-Bank products can add a 0.025% relationship bonus on top of base Silver APY. It also covers the linking steps, requires same ownership and tax ID, notes authorization workflow and that APY changes appear shortly after linking, and states that keeping both accounts open/in good standing (and not unlinking) is required to maintain bonuses.
